title: Dimensions of Sockets for Relays Used in Electronic and Telecommunication Equipment, Part 1: Sockets for Armature Relays - Section 2 : 11 Pin Socket
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 12195 (PART 1)) prescribes technical specifications, requirements, tolerances, and testing procedures for Dimensions of Sockets for Relays Used in Electronic and Telecommunication Equipment, Part 1: Sockets for Armature Relays - Section 2 : 11 Pin Socket.
clause_3_terminology: Dimensions of Sockets for Relays Used in Electronic and Telecommunication Equipment

electrical_and_safety_parameters: insulation resistance of 200 Mohms, Mln at 500 V
marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
